title: A Job No One Can See

collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: A fisher wonders whether distant people might spend their days doing work that produces nothing visible.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A fisher wonders whether distant people might spend their days doing work that produces no visible fish, baskets, houses, or crops.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Researchers invent professions devoted to counting, organizing, teaching, planning, and solving disputes.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A builder asks how anyone would know whether such work was done well; the group devises standards and checks.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A parent proposes that listening, teaching, nursing, and supporting others are real work even when nothing tangible remains.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Someone asks why care is sometimes overlooked when it is unpaid; a lively discussion follows.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: An apprentice dreams of learning several crafts rather than inheriting one.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A villager warns that choice may be limited by family obligations, illness, or scarcity.
